html:
Traveling from Saigon to Mui Ne by private car is a convenient and comfortable way to make the journey. Mui Ne is a popular coastal city in Vietnam known for its beautiful beaches and sand dunes.

The distance between Ho Chi Minh City and Mui Ne is approximately 220 kilometers (137 miles), and the journey usually takes around 3 – 4 hours, depending on road conditions and stops along the way. Unlike other transport from Saigon to Mui Ne such as grab cars, traditional taxis, or buses, it is inconvenient and easy to get scams.

Traveling by private car offers flexibility and comfort, allowing you to enjoy the journey at your own pace. It’s a popular choice for those who prefer a more personalized and convenient mode of transportation from Ho Chi Minh City to Mui Ne.

SAIGON TO MUI NE BY PRIVATE CAR

If you land at Tan Son Nhat International Airport and would like to get a private car to travel to Mui Ne, Vietlook Travel will arrange a comfortable car and experienced driver to pick you up.

Please inform us of your flight number, landing time, the number of people as well as your hotel name/ address in Mui Ne. Our driver will wait for you at the Saigon Airport arrival gate with your full name on a welcome board so you can easily recognize him. Then he will transfer you safely to your hotel in Mui Ne.

If you request us to pick you up at a hotel in Saigon, you can choose the pickup time. Our experienced driver will be ready at your hotel lobby and remind you to collect all the passports.

Because this is your private car transfer, you can choose the direct transfer which takes 3 hours by private car. If you like, along the way from Ho Chi Minh City to Mui Ne, you can request our driver to stop at places for you to have lunch, drink some Vietnamese coffee, or take a short break.

Upon arrival at Mui Ne Hotel, he will help you get the luggage and check the car to make sure you forget nothing and say goodbye to you. We finished the Private Car Saigon to Mui Ne Transfer. Vietlook Travel wishes you a great stay in Mui Ne.
